headline: Classic Survival is easy to find; mode objectives, boss progression, throne recovery and per-run clocks are corrected.
shipped: Classic Survival has its own original-game card and play button; alternate modes and survival challenges share a readable desktop/mobile picker.
Descriptions explain Boss Rush warmups, endless Timed Survival, optional Boss Gauntlet par, Extraction exit thresholds and Throne retry; numeric copy stays derived from gameplay facts.
Boss Gauntlet opens with a boss and advances through six distinct solo fights; the sixth defeat ends in victory without a seventh wave.
Throne recovery reactivates the first lost point after the remaining captures; a second loss ends the run. The retake notice fits mobile screens.
Score Attack shows time remaining; Timed Survival shows tenths; clocks reset each run. Classic and Operations clear previously selected alternate-mode flags.
Boss defeat effects use the existing runtime helper; App now rejects undefined references during lint. Boss intro geometry is centered and honors reduced motion.
validation: 257 files / 1,608 tests passed; strict lint and deployable build passed; public contract 28 files and claims passed; dependency audit zero vulnerabilities. Seventeen short natural-input runs cover all twelve desktop modes and Classic plus four new mobile modes. Four controlled six-boss sequences reached victory. Sixteen browser clock/ending cases and four Classic/Operation launch transitions passed. Seven Throne recovery paths were simulated independently. Final visual receipt and production promotion are being sealed.

limits.title: Natural completion not universal
limits.why: Controlled outcomes and short input runs prove different things; no claim that every mode or Operation was played through naturally.
